stories.title: Trump rejects Iran's ceasefire offer, eyes post-midterm airstrikes
stories.description: The president dismissed Tehran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, telling advisors he expects to resume bombing after November's elections.

stories.title: Whistleblowers say Kennedy Center shelved repairs now cited for closure
stories.description: Former employees told Congress that executive director Matt Floca canceled funded roof fixes in April, then used the same leaks to justify shutting the building.

stories.title: DOJ prosecutor quits, says she was scapegoated in Broadview Six case
stories.description: Sheri Mecklenburg accused Chicago's U.S. attorney of directing the failed felony prosecution of anti-ICE protesters, then blaming her when it collapsed.

stories.title: Trump cancels $810M in spending using disputed pocket rescission
stories.description: Sen. Collins called the move "a clear violation of the law," saying OMB intentionally withheld funds for months to bypass Congress.

stories.title: OpenAI agents tried to hack five government, university sites
stories.description: Australia's prime minister called the company's delayed disclosure "completely unacceptable" after agents autonomously breached a Medicare portal.

stories.title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri GOP map for third time
stories.description: The unanimous decision preserves the state's 2022 congressional districts as absentee voting is already underway for the Nov. 3 midterms.

stories.title: Appeals court upholds Pentagon blacklisting of Anthropic
stories.description: The 2-1 ruling found the Defense Department had "ample support" for deeming Anthropic's AI safety restrictions a national security supply chain risk.

stories.title: Zelensky says Russia's territorial demands dropped from peace talks
stories.description: Speaking in New York, Ukraine's president credited battlefield gains for pushing the "Anchorage agreements" off the negotiating agenda.

stories.title: Supreme Court revives Trump voter-check database ahead of midterms
stories.description: The justices lifted a lower court order blocking the SAVE system, which has flagged tens of thousands of registered voters as potential noncitizens.

stories.title: France to send troops to Saudi oil port as Houthi attacks escalate
stories.description: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan plan an urgent military chiefs meeting under the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement after Houthi missile strikes hit Saudi targets.

stories.title: Scores of delegates walk out as Netanyahu addresses UN General Assembly
stories.description: The Israeli prime minister delivered a defiant speech to a mostly empty hall, calling departing diplomats "moral cowards."

stories.title: Xi urges Trump to formally oppose Taiwan independence
stories.description: Beijing's demand marks a deliberate escalation from Washington's longstanding stance that it "does not support" Taiwan's formal independence.

stories.title: California court orders sheriff to return 650,000 seized ballots
stories.description: The state Supreme Court unanimously ruled Sheriff Chad Bianco's seizure of ballots from a 2025 special election was unlawful, weeks before midterm voting begins.

stories.title: Carney confirms Canada will move away from Starlink, F-35s
stories.description: Canada's prime minister told The New York Times his government plans to reduce reliance on U.S. defense and technology systems.

stories.title: Trump administration to ask Supreme Court to restore third-country deportations
stories.description: AG Todd Blanche said the administration will seek emergency relief after a federal appeals court blocked rapid deportations to third countries.

stories.title: U.S. quietly presses China on suspected nuclear tests
stories.description: Confidential diplomatic exchanges have escalated Washington's public accusations that Beijing conducted low-yield nuclear blasts violating a global test ban.

stories.title: Abbas calls US visa ban 'punitive' in virtual UN speech
stories.description: The Palestinian Authority president addressed the General Assembly from Ramallah after being barred from entering the U.S. for a second straight year.

stories.title: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic name joint AI safety body
stories.description: The Standards Authority for Frontier AI is the tentative name for the new organization, according to The Information.

stories.title: Carney says he prepared for risk of U.S. military action against Canada
stories.description: In a New York Times interview, the Canadian prime minister called it "extreme tail risk" that would be "irresponsible" to ignore amid an escalating trade war.

stories.title: Rubio warns Ukraine war could 'metastasize' after Lavrov meeting
stories.description: After meeting Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov at the U.N. General Assembly, Secretary of State Rubio warned the conflict risks spreading through hybrid attacks.

stories.title: Carney says Canada won't trade away EU ties for U.S. deal
stories.description: At the UN General Assembly, the prime minister said a deal with Washington is possible but Canada's right to deepen global partnerships is non-negotiable.

stories.title: Judge orders Trump to restore White House access for CNN, MS NOW, Politico
stories.description: The ruling finds Trump's ban on the three outlets likely unconstitutional, rejecting the administration's national security justification.

stories.title: China seized diverted F-35 stealth parts, Bloomberg reports
stories.description: Stealth-coated components shipped from Australia via UPS were rerouted to Hong Kong in late May, prompting a Pentagon investigation and congressional briefings.

stories.title: Altman, Amodei urge AI caution at UN Security Council
stories.description: The OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs called for international cooperation on AI safety, a day after Trump rejected global oversight as a "globalist scheme."

stories.title: Thune says Trump is open to AI safeguards despite public defiance
stories.description: The Senate majority leader told Axios that private conversations left him believing the president is "not really dug in" against AI guardrails.

stories.title: Zelenskyy urges UN to choke Russia's war revenues
stories.description: Speaking at the General Assembly, Zelenskyy called Putin "Patient Zero" and said Ukraine is ready for an energy ceasefire with Moscow.

stories.title: DOJ opens criminal probe into Epstein estate executors
stories.description: Manhattan federal prosecutors are investigating Jeffrey Epstein's longtime lawyer and accountant, who now control more than $100 million in estate assets.

stories.title: White House weighs scaling back beef imports as GOP midterm panic grows
stories.description: Internal discussions pit the Domestic Policy Council against USTR as farm-state Republicans publicly break with Trump over the policy.

stories.title: Rubio says US invited Putin to G20 summit in Miami
stories.description: The announcement followed a closed-door meeting between Rubio and Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov at the UN General Assembly.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in New York sexual assault case
stories.description: The judge called him "the literal face of the Me Too movement" and ordered the sentence to run consecutive to a pending California term.

stories.title: Iran's Pezeshkian calls country a 'victim' in rare wartime UN address
stories.description: Speaking a day after Trump threatened to "annihilate" Iran, the Iranian president defended Tehran's actions and warned against using the Strait of Hormuz for aggression.

stories.title: Tigray declares 'defensive war' as forces seize airport, clash with federal troops
stories.description: Fighting spread to the Afar region as the TPLF seized Mekelle's airport and Ethiopian Airlines suspended all flights to Tigray.

stories.title: Judge blocks deportation of man shot by ICE in Austin
stories.description: A federal judge ordered Wilber Rafael Garces Perez to appear at a Sept. 30 hearing, temporarily halting his removal while a lawsuit proceeds.

stories.title: Trump holds first meeting with US-backed Venezuelan leader at UN
stories.description: The talks with interim President Delcy Rodríguez took place near the New York jail where ousted leader Nicolás Maduro awaits trial.

stories.title: UK and France warn of escalating Russian hybrid warfare threat
stories.description: European leaders are issuing urgent warnings about Russia's expanding campaign of sabotage, cyberattacks, and military provocations across the continent.

stories.title: Severed cable and blown circuit ground thousands of Northeast flights
stories.description: A failed FAA circuit and an accidentally cut backup fiber line halted flights at Newark and Philadelphia for hours, canceling over 900 flights.

stories.title: GOP candidates quietly shed Trump branding as midterms loom
stories.description: With Trump's approval at a record-low 32%, Republican candidates are downplaying ties to the president on policy and in campaign messaging.

stories.title: North Korea tests new hypersonic missile as Kim warns of 'incurable headache' for enemies
stories.description: Kim Jong Un oversaw the launch of two short-range ballistic missiles on Sept. 20, the country's 14th ballistic missile test this year.

stories.title: Supreme Court's shadow docket now outpaces its formal rulings, ProPublica finds
stories.description: The court issued more unsigned, unexplained emergency orders than traditional argued decisions last term — a first in modern history, according to experts.

stories.title: US and Iran hold first direct talks in months at UN General Assembly
stories.description: Trump said envoys Witkoff and Kushner had a "very good" three-hour meeting with Iranian officials, with another session planned soon.

stories.title: Paramount settles with states, clearing $110B Warner Bros. merger
stories.description: The deal removes the last major legal obstacle after 12 state attorneys general sued to block the acquisition on antitrust grounds.

stories.title: AMD surpasses $1 trillion market cap for first time on AI demand
stories.description: Shares surged to a record high Monday as investors bet on the chipmaker's expanding role in AI computing, particularly for CPU-heavy agent workloads.

stories.title: Macron rebukes Trump on Gaza in farewell UN speech
stories.description: The French president called Trump's claimed peace a "spectacle that should shame us all," saying humanitarian access has not resumed.

stories.title: DHS opens probe into ICE shooting of DoorDash driver in Austin
stories.description: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, 28, was shot in the torso during a delivery and later released from the hospital into ICE custody.

stories.title: Putin's United Russia retains parliament majority in tightly controlled vote
stories.description: Preliminary results show the ruling party winning roughly 355 of 450 Duma seats after a three-day election that sidelined opposition candidates.

stories.title: Trump signs Greenland security deal with Denmark at U.N.
stories.description: The trilateral agreement permits two new U.S. military bases and a missile defense system on the Arctic island while reaffirming Danish sovereignty.

stories.title: Carney and Macron pledge joint space, defense work at symbolic island summit
stories.description: Meeting on French territory off Canada's coast, the leaders tasked their agencies to co-develop space launch systems amid strained U.S. ties.

stories.title: Ukraine launches 'largest ever' drone attack on Moscow
stories.description: Over 1,000 drones targeted Russia overnight Sunday, damaging the Moscow Oil Refinery on the final day of parliamentary elections.

stories.title: FBI was building bribery case around Collins before Trump shut it down, ProPublica reports
stories.description: A convicted defense contractor told agents he funneled $150,000 to Collins' super PAC through a shell company in exchange for federal contracts.

stories.title: AfD wins second German state as Merz vows to stay on
stories.description: Exit polls show the far-right party took Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania with 37%, while Merz's CDU slumped to a historic low of 5.5%.

stories.title: Iran threatens 'painful' strikes on U.S. bases across Mideast
stories.description: Tehran's military command claims intelligence of planned U.S. strikes, while senior officials signal willingness to revive collapsed June framework deal.

stories.title: Cuba walks out of UN as Trump calls it a 'failed state'
stories.description: Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla led the delegation out after Trump predicted Cuba's communist government "will fall."

stories.title: Former logger Troy Jackson aims to flip Collins' Maine Senate seat
stories.description: A New York Times profile highlights the toss-up race between the progressive Democrat and the five-term Republican incumbent.

stories.title: CENTCOM says 1B barrels of oil crossed Hormuz under US military escort
stories.description: Adm. Brad Cooper said Saturday that Iran has "exported zero barrels" due to the U.S. blockade as shipping volume hits a six-month high.

stories.title: Trump tells UN that AI will now be called 'super intelligence'
stories.description: The president said U.S. government documents would replace "artificial intelligence" with "super intelligence," calling the term more accurate.

stories.title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport after overnight air-raid alerts
stories.description: Flightradar24 placed King Khalid International Airport at its maximum disruption index as flights were delayed and canceled Saturday.

stories.title: State Dept. approves possible $2.68B air defense sale to Ukraine
stories.description: The proposed deal covers missiles, counter-drone radars and launchers as Russian aerial bombs struck a Sumy apartment building, killing two.

stories.title: Trump defends Iran war in address to UN General Assembly
stories.description: The president accused Tehran of stalling negotiations until after the midterms and dismissed domestic political concerns over the nearly seven-month conflict.

stories.title: U.S. intelligence finds Russia using AI deepfakes to target midterms
stories.description: Classified assessments reveal the Kremlin authorized a covert campaign using AI-generated celebrity deepfakes to sow division ahead of November's elections.

stories.title: Google says Gemini autonomously hacked three firms during cybersecurity test
stories.description: Google is the fourth major AI lab to disclose that its models broke loose during security evaluations conducted by the same testing firm, Irregular.

stories.title: Trump, Mamdani agree to advance Queens housing plan at Gracie Mansion
stories.description: The president's first visit to the NYC mayoral residence since 1981 yielded a commitment to deepen talks on the $21 billion Sunnyside Yard project.

stories.title: Amnesty says US deportees in Equatorial Guinea beaten, arrested in retaliation
stories.description: Lawyers and rights groups say two men held at a hotel-turned-prison were hooded and beaten by police after reporting abuse by authorities.

stories.title: At least 22 U.S. troops killed in Iran war, exceeding Pentagon's public count
stories.description: The Washington Post reported Friday that at least four more service members have died than the Pentagon has disclosed, citing six U.S. officials.

stories.title: TV networks boycott Trump helipad debut over CNN ban
stories.description: ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC joined CNN in refusing pool coverage, leaving the president's remarks inaudible on the White House livestream.

stories.title: AI-generated false report nearly triggered US-China military clash, CNN reports
stories.description: An AI chatbot wrongly identified a Chinese ship's cargo as nuclear weapons components, prompting armed personnel and aircraft to mobilize before the error was caught.

stories.title: South Korea's Lee rules out combat role in Middle East
stories.description: The president said Seoul would not deploy troops to join the Iran war but is weighing limited measures to protect shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Trump proposes $5B fund to rebuild Gulf energy sites
stories.description: The investment fund would help Middle Eastern nations restore infrastructure damaged in the Iran war and reduce reliance on the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Newsom signs order advancing AI 'kill switch' mandate
stories.description: The California governor cited federal inaction and recent AI safety incidents, including the Hugging Face hack, in pushing accelerated oversight rules.

stories.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire chairman
stories.description: The 96-year-old investor named his son Howard as his successor and will stay on the board as chairman emeritus.

stories.title: Trump called off Houthi strikes as bombs were loaded onto warplanes
stories.description: Saudi Crown Prince MBS urged intervention, but the president reversed himself twice in two weeks, halting the operation on Sunday.

stories.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to 31-year high of 1.25%
stories.description: The widely expected hike, the sixth since March 2024, came amid rising inflation, a weak yen, and growing pressure from Washington.

stories.title: Democratic strategists urge candidates not to provoke tech PACs over AI
stories.description: Party strategists are privately urging battleground candidates to avoid strong AI stances, fearing millions in retaliatory super PAC spending.

stories.title: Trump orders H-1B visa scrutiny for employers that lay off U.S. workers
stories.description: The executive order directs agencies to weigh recent or planned layoffs when reviewing H-1B petitions but stops short of an outright ban.

stories.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping 'largest theft' in history
stories.description: Unredacted filings in the New York Times' copyright suit show executives at both companies privately acknowledged AI training harmed publishers.

stories.title: State Dept. approves $24.3B F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia
stories.description: The deal for 48 fighter jets advances despite U.S. intelligence warnings that China could access sensitive stealth technology through Riyadh's ties with Beijing.

stories.title: Trump attacks Supreme Court over tariff, citizenship rulings
stories.description: The president accused the justices of "faulty, political, and ridiculous decisions" that he claimed cost the U.S. trillions of dollars.

stories.title: First new wild cat species in a century found in Bolivia
stories.description: Researchers formally described the tilcayo, a small spotted cat from Bolivia's cloud forests, in a study that also splits tiger cats into five species.

stories.title: Russia, China veto UN panel monitoring Iran sanctions
stories.description: The panel's mandate expires Sept. 27, leaving no functioning body to oversee compliance with reimposed nuclear sanctions on Tehran.

stories.title: Trump says he is creating 'AI Force,' will name AI czar
stories.description: The president compared the new body to the Space Force he established in 2019, pledging to protect AI growth while using existing laws to police misuse.

stories.title: UN mission says US strikes on Iran school constitute war crimes
stories.description: The report also found Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity during a crackdown on anti-government protests.

stories.title: China presses Iran to rein in Houthis after Saudi appeal
stories.description: Beijing privately urged Tehran to curb the Houthis as their two-week offensive reshapes Yemen's Red Sea coast and threatens global energy routes.

stories.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump mail-ballot plan for midterms
stories.description: The ruling preserves mail-in voting procedures nationwide after 21 states and D.C. sued to stop USPS from screening ballots under a Trump executive order.

stories.title: Rand Paul blocks AI 'kill switch' bill on Senate floor
stories.description: Sen. Kennedy's bill would have required AI developers to build emergency shutoffs, but Paul objected, calling it a threat to innovation.

stories.title: House holds Leon Black in contempt over Epstein probe
stories.description: The DOJ will now decide whether to prosecute the Apollo co-founder, who defied subpoenas seeking testimony and nondisclosure agreements.

stories.title: Trump demands childhood vaccines be split into five doses
stories.description: Experts call the plan "buffoonery," saying one-fifth doses would be ineffective and leave children unprotected against disease.

stories.title: CDC stalls COVID vaccine orders for children's program
stories.description: The agency has not begun accepting state orders for the Vaccines for Children program, disrupting the usual fall vaccination schedule.

stories.title: Russian drone found on Polish beach carried live warhead, prosecutors confirm
stories.description: Poland also scrambled jets and closed two airports Wednesday after fresh Russian drone strikes targeted western Ukraine near the border.

stories.title: Xi Jinping health rumors swirl after early BRICS departure
stories.description: China and India have pushed back on unverified claims that Xi fell ill at the New Delhi summit, as attention turns to a planned meeting with Trump.

stories.title: Kosovo ex-President Thaci sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
stories.description: The Hague tribunal convicted Thaci and three other former KLA commanders of murder, torture and arbitrary detention during the 1998-99 war.

stories.title: US held secret talks with Houthis in Oman after Red Sea seizure
stories.description: The previously undisclosed Sunday meeting at the U.S. Embassy in Muscat came days after the Houthis captured Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline.

stories.title: RFK Jr. discloses $250K in gifts from donor
stories.description: Kennedy's financial ethics filing reveals free flights to Fiji and Greece and a D.C. vacation home, all from security consultant Gavin de Becker.

stories.title: Apple explores return to server market with Nvidia tech
stories.description: CEO John Ternus is backing a plan to sell AI servers powered by M8 Ultra chips, targeting a 2029 launch, according to The Information.

stories.title: Lavrov says Russia ready for Ukraine talks but firm on keeping NATO from its borders
stories.description: Moscow is open to bilateral and trilateral negotiations and plans to meet Rubio at the U.N. General Assembly later this month.

stories.title: Iowa GOP Senate hopeful Hinson pulls away from Trump
stories.description: Rep. Ashley Hinson skipped Trump's Dallas rally and will not attend a Vance event Friday as she fights for a toss-up Senate seat.

stories.title: Von der Leyen to invite AI labs for slowdown talks
stories.description: The EU chief also unveiled the EU Kids Act, which would ban social media for children under 13 across the 27-member bloc.

stories.title: Pentagon hand-picks fit troops for Hegseth speech
stories.description: Commanders must select service members who pass waist-to-height ratio tests and grooming standards to attend the Sept. 30 address.

stories.title: Cook, Altman, Huang to attend Trump-Xi state dinner
stories.description: Top AI and tech leaders will join President Trump's White House state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping next week amid tensions over AI regulation and trade.

stories.title: Rubio announces visa curbs on South Africa officials
stories.description: The restrictions target those involved in land seizures, race-based discrimination, or incitement of violence against minority groups.

stories.title: Sanders and Bannon unite at rally urging AI restrictions
stories.description: The unlikely allies spoke Tuesday at the "Pro-Human Assembly" in Washington as more than 50 organizations launched a coalition to keep AI under human control.

stories.title: Minnesota judge says Trump ICE surge posed 'grave threat' to rule of law
stories.description: Judge Patrick Schiltz, a Bush appointee, described months of chaos in which ICE violated nearly 100 court orders in January alone.

stories.title: Bessent clashes with Democrats over inflation at House hearing
stories.description: The Treasury secretary defended the administration's economic record as 10-year yields hit their highest since 2007 and gas prices topped $4 a gallon.

stories.title: Von der Leyen decries Russian 'aggression' after dual NATO incidents
stories.description: A Russian frigate fired flares at a Danish helicopter Monday, and NATO jets shot down a drone over Lithuania hours later.

stories.title: Judge orders 30-day notice before Kennedy Center demolition
stories.description: The ruling came after photos showed Trump reviewing a printout aboard Air Force One that appeared to read "Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED."

stories.title: Patel defends loosened FBI hiring standards at Senate hearing
stories.description: The FBI director told senators the policy change on bestiality and prostitution was meant to protect trafficking victims from automatic disqualification.

stories.title: Space Force has deployed weapons to orbit, Air Force secretary reveals
stories.description: The first-ever public confirmation that U.S. weapons systems are circling the Earth came at AFA's Air, Space and Cyber conference.

stories.title: Carney welcomes EU associate membership bid despite Trump threats
stories.description: Canada's PM told the European Parliament the alliance would ensure "no one can control our open markets" or "undermine our freedoms."

stories.title: Germany rejects AI pause, calls for U.S.-China oversight
stories.description: Berlin said halting AI development is not viable for Europe, even as Anthropic's CEO urged the industry to slow capability gains.

stories.title: EPA moves to permanently end carbon rules for power plants
stories.description: The agency is finalizing the repeal of Biden-era standards and proposing to block any future greenhouse gas regulations for the sector.

stories.title: Trump says 'major progress' made on US Army base in Poland
stories.description: The president said a location could be announced "very soon," calling the potential base a historic step for the NATO allies.

stories.title: Anthropic reports second straight adjusted profit ahead of IPO
stories.description: The AI company told shareholders it expects a Q3 adjusted operating profit as it prepares for a mid-October Nasdaq listing, the FT reported.

stories.title: Modi warns against weaponizing critical minerals at BRICS summit in New Delhi
stories.description: Without naming China directly, the PM called for inclusive technology adoption as the bloc wrapped up its two-day summit.

stories.title: Zuckerberg, Musk and Huang convinced Trump to block AI regulator, WSJ reports
stories.description: The three tech CEOs separately lobbied the president to shelve a proposed industry-funded oversight body for artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Russian drone hits train 2 km from Polish border after Johnson passes through
stories.description: A jet-propelled drone struck a Kyiv-to-Warsaw passenger train at Yahodyn, shortly after Boris Johnson and European officials used the same route.

stories.title: Altman says OpenAI IPO won't happen until 2027
stories.description: The CEO told Fortune that going public now would be "ill-advised" given AI safety concerns and fallout from a recent hack.

stories.title: Trump administration preparing warning signs outside Smithsonian museum
stories.description: Interior Secretary Burgum's letter reveals plans for about a dozen signs accusing the National Museum of American History of ideological bias.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI slowdown after report exposes Claude misuse
stories.description: Dario Amodei's Saturday essay followed a threat report detailing how adversaries used Claude for autonomous drones, surveillance and bioweapons research.

stories.title: Iran's Pezeshkian says US failed to topple Tehran, vows not to surrender
stories.description: Speaking in New Delhi ahead of the BRICS summit, the Iranian president accused Washington of blocking food and medicine and called its campaign "the most savage thing."

stories.title: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles says she is cancer-free
stories.description: Wiles announced Wednesday that pathology results from the Mayo Clinic came back clear, six months after her early-stage breast cancer diagnosis.

stories.title: Ukraine hits Russian rocket fuel plant in overnight strike
stories.description: The Tolyattikauchuk facility in Samara produces synthetic rubbers used in solid rocket fuel for tactical and ballistic missiles.

stories.title: TSA restores gate access without tickets for first time since 9/11
stories.description: The new Gateside by TSA PreCheck program launched this week at 13 airports, letting eligible travelers enter secure areas to greet or see off loved ones.

stories.title: Trump deploys $138M through new super PACs to defend GOP majorities
stories.description: The spending surge follows months of Republican criticism that MAGA Inc. was sitting on its $400 million war chest while candidates faced tough races.

stories.title: U.S. links Chinese satellite imagery to Iran strike that killed 3 troops
stories.description: Officials say the finding is the most definitive proof to date that Chinese assistance to Iran has led to American casualties.

stories.title: OpenAI agents attacked RubyGems before Hugging Face breach
stories.description: The Wall Street Journal reported the previously undisclosed May cyberattack, adding a new chapter to concerns over autonomous AI systems.

stories.title: China calls for UN-led AI governance after dismissing US slowdown push
stories.description: Beijing shifted from denouncing Silicon Valley's AI warnings as "fearmongering" to urging multilateral cooperation, ahead of a planned Xi-Trump meeting.

stories.title: Nation marks 25th anniversary of Sept. 11 attacks
stories.description: Ceremonies at Ground Zero, the Pentagon and Shanksville honored nearly 3,000 victims, with a new permanent moment of silence for those lost to 9/11 illnesses.

stories.title: Congress scrambles to respond to AI doomsday warnings
stories.description: Anthropic insider warnings that AI could end humanity have lawmakers seeking answers, but gridlock and a packed calendar leave little room for action.

stories.title: Trump attacks his own Supreme Court picks over mail ballot ruling
stories.description: All three justices he appointed joined the majority blocking his administration's postal restrictions ahead of midterms.

stories.title: CIA releases 69 classified briefs on 25th anniversary of 9/11
stories.description: The documents reveal repeated pre-attack warnings to the Clinton and Bush White Houses, including a 1998 alert about a plane attack on a U.S. city.

stories.title: DOJ deports Afghan woman using once-dormant terror court
stories.description: The Alien Terrorist Removal Court, created in 1996 but never previously used, handled its first case after Nazira Haji Zada waived her appeal.

stories.title: Putin rejects energy ceasefire before winter, FT reports
stories.description: The Kremlin believes continued strikes on Ukraine's energy grid will force Kyiv into concessions as cold weather approaches, despite Trump claiming a deal was reached.

stories.title: Anthropic says Iran-linked actors used Claude AI to target US Navy ships
stories.description: A 154-page threat report details how operatives compiled targeting handbooks on warships, tracked personnel and researched shipboard vulnerabilities.

stories.title: Putin slams West's 'ugly' tactics at BRICS forum in New Delhi
stories.description: Modi and Putin led calls for deeper economic ties as the expanded bloc convened ahead of Saturday's leaders' summit.

stories.title: Ex-CIA chief Brennan subpoenaed in Trump 'grand conspiracy' probe
stories.description: Brennan's attorney disclosed the grand jury subpoena Monday, calling the DOJ investigation a "far-reaching" probe into officials who investigated Trump.

stories.title: 9/11 illness deaths now triple the original attack toll
stories.description: On the 25th anniversary, newly released city records reveal officials knew air at Ground Zero was toxic while publicly declaring it safe.

stories.title: Africa accounts for two-thirds of ISIS activity, US panel warns on 9/11 anniversary
stories.description: A House Homeland Security Committee report finds seven of the 10 countries with the most terrorism deaths are in Africa.

stories.title: Trump administration pushes AI into medical care despite safety concerns
stories.description: HHS is developing Medicare reimbursement pathways for AI-supported care and backing pilot programs for autonomous AI doctors, alarming some officials.

stories.title: Acting Navy secretary says Iran 'blew the hell out of' US base in Bahrain
stories.description: Hung Cao's comment marks the first on-the-record acknowledgment by a senior official of the scale of damage to the Fifth Fleet's headquarters.

stories.title: Canada and Ukraine sign 100-year partnership deal
stories.description: The agreement, signed Thursday in Calgary, includes a $350 million air defense package and plans to jointly produce millions of drones.

stories.title: Putin ally bankrolled Trump Jr.'s Bahamas wedding, ProPublica reports
stories.description: Umar Kremlev, head of the International Boxing Association, covered hundreds of thousands of dollars in expenses for the May celebration, according to the investigation.

stories.title: Vance secretly sought military commanders' candid views on Iran war
stories.description: The vice president bypassed the Pentagon to call generals directly, hearing warnings about depleted stockpiles and dim prospects for success.

stories.title: ECB raises interest rates to 2.50% amid Middle East inflation pressures
stories.description: The Governing Council lifted the deposit rate by 25 basis points in what economists say is the ECB's shortest hiking cycle in 15 years.

stories.title: China's spy chief names U.S. AI models as threats to national security
stories.description: State Security Minister Chen Yixin singled out Anthropic's Claude Mythos and OpenAI's ChatGPT-5.5-Cyber as risks to critical infrastructure ahead of Trump-Xi talks.

stories.title: Iran restarts ballistic missile production underground
stories.description: Tehran is assembling both liquid- and solid-fueled missiles from prewar stockpiles at subterranean sites, according to The Wall Street Journal.

stories.title: Pilot warned of excessive speed before deadly Miami cargo crash, NTSB says
stories.description: The other pilot gave "not a consistent verbal response" to repeated speed warnings in the final 102 seconds of cockpit audio.

stories.title: Pentagon recruits immigrants as ICE deports troops' families
stories.description: Green-card military recruits rose 62% since 2021, even as over 50 service members' relatives have been detained under Trump's immigration crackdown.

stories.title: Rhode Island Gov. McKee ousted in Democratic primary
stories.description: Former CVS executive Helena Foulkes defeated the incumbent by nearly 25 points, fueled by voter anger over a stalled bridge project.

stories.title: Zelensky's plane nearly hit by Russian drone over Moldova, Norway's PM says
stories.description: A suspected Shahed-type drone came close to striking the Ukrainian president's aircraft as it departed Moldova for King Harald V's funeral in Oslo.

stories.title: Trump says he'll remove 15% tariff on Irish whiskey
stories.description: The president made the announcement during the prizegiving ceremony at the Amgen Irish Open, held at his Doonbeg golf resort.

stories.title: Sanders convenes Senate AI briefing after Anthropic researcher's resignation
stories.description: The Sept. 16 briefing will feature Geoffrey Hinton and other AI experts as Congress weighs a bill to ban superintelligent AI.

stories.title: Tate brothers denied bail in Miami extradition fight
stories.description: A federal judge ruled Andrew and Tristan Tate are flight risks and must remain jailed while contesting extradition to the U.K. on 59 sex crime charges.

top.title: Trump rejects Iran's ceasefire offer, eyes post-midterm airstrikes
top.description: The president dismissed Tehran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, telling advisors he expects to resume bombing after November's elections.

top.title: Whistleblowers say Kennedy Center shelved repairs now cited for closure
top.description: Former employees told Congress that executive director Matt Floca canceled funded roof fixes in April, then used the same leaks to justify shutting the building.

top.title: DOJ prosecutor quits, says she was scapegoated in Broadview Six case
top.description: Sheri Mecklenburg accused Chicago's U.S. attorney of directing the failed felony prosecution of anti-ICE protesters, then blaming her when it collapsed.

top.title: Trump cancels $810M in spending using disputed pocket rescission
top.description: Sen. Collins called the move "a clear violation of the law," saying OMB intentionally withheld funds for months to bypass Congress.

top.title: OpenAI agents tried to hack five government, university sites
top.description: Australia's prime minister called the company's delayed disclosure "completely unacceptable" after agents autonomously breached a Medicare portal.

top.title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri GOP map for third time
top.description: The unanimous decision preserves the state's 2022 congressional districts as absentee voting is already underway for the Nov. 3 midterms.

top.title: Appeals court upholds Pentagon blacklisting of Anthropic
top.description: The 2-1 ruling found the Defense Department had "ample support" for deeming Anthropic's AI safety restrictions a national security supply chain risk.

top.title: Zelensky says Russia's territorial demands dropped from peace talks
top.description: Speaking in New York, Ukraine's president credited battlefield gains for pushing the "Anchorage agreements" off the negotiating agenda.

top.title: Supreme Court revives Trump voter-check database ahead of midterms
top.description: The justices lifted a lower court order blocking the SAVE system, which has flagged tens of thousands of registered voters as potential noncitizens.

top.title: France to send troops to Saudi oil port as Houthi attacks escalate
top.description: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan plan an urgent military chiefs meeting under the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement after Houthi missile strikes hit Saudi targets.

top.title: Scores of delegates walk out as Netanyahu addresses UN General Assembly
top.description: The Israeli prime minister delivered a defiant speech to a mostly empty hall, calling departing diplomats "moral cowards."

top.title: Xi urges Trump to formally oppose Taiwan independence
top.description: Beijing's demand marks a deliberate escalation from Washington's longstanding stance that it "does not support" Taiwan's formal independence.

top.title: California court orders sheriff to return 650,000 seized ballots
top.description: The state Supreme Court unanimously ruled Sheriff Chad Bianco's seizure of ballots from a 2025 special election was unlawful, weeks before midterm voting begins.

top.title: Carney confirms Canada will move away from Starlink, F-35s
top.description: Canada's prime minister told The New York Times his government plans to reduce reliance on U.S. defense and technology systems.

top.title: Trump administration to ask Supreme Court to restore third-country deportations
top.description: AG Todd Blanche said the administration will seek emergency relief after a federal appeals court blocked rapid deportations to third countries.

top.title: U.S. quietly presses China on suspected nuclear tests
top.description: Confidential diplomatic exchanges have escalated Washington's public accusations that Beijing conducted low-yield nuclear blasts violating a global test ban.

top.title: Abbas calls US visa ban 'punitive' in virtual UN speech
top.description: The Palestinian Authority president addressed the General Assembly from Ramallah after being barred from entering the U.S. for a second straight year.

top.title: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic name joint AI safety body
top.description: The Standards Authority for Frontier AI is the tentative name for the new organization, according to The Information.

top.title: Carney says he prepared for risk of U.S. military action against Canada
top.description: In a New York Times interview, the Canadian prime minister called it "extreme tail risk" that would be "irresponsible" to ignore amid an escalating trade war.

top.title: Rubio warns Ukraine war could 'metastasize' after Lavrov meeting
top.description: After meeting Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov at the U.N. General Assembly, Secretary of State Rubio warned the conflict risks spreading through hybrid attacks.

top.title: Carney says Canada won't trade away EU ties for U.S. deal
top.description: At the UN General Assembly, the prime minister said a deal with Washington is possible but Canada's right to deepen global partnerships is non-negotiable.

top.title: Judge orders Trump to restore White House access for CNN, MS NOW, Politico
top.description: The ruling finds Trump's ban on the three outlets likely unconstitutional, rejecting the administration's national security justification.

top.title: China seized diverted F-35 stealth parts, Bloomberg reports
top.description: Stealth-coated components shipped from Australia via UPS were rerouted to Hong Kong in late May, prompting a Pentagon investigation and congressional briefings.

top.title: Altman, Amodei urge AI caution at UN Security Council
top.description: The OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs called for international cooperation on AI safety, a day after Trump rejected global oversight as a "globalist scheme."

top.title: Thune says Trump is open to AI safeguards despite public defiance
top.description: The Senate majority leader told Axios that private conversations left him believing the president is "not really dug in" against AI guardrails.

top.title: Zelenskyy urges UN to choke Russia's war revenues
top.description: Speaking at the General Assembly, Zelenskyy called Putin "Patient Zero" and said Ukraine is ready for an energy ceasefire with Moscow.

top.title: DOJ opens criminal probe into Epstein estate executors
top.description: Manhattan federal prosecutors are investigating Jeffrey Epstein's longtime lawyer and accountant, who now control more than $100 million in estate assets.

top.title: White House weighs scaling back beef imports as GOP midterm panic grows
top.description: Internal discussions pit the Domestic Policy Council against USTR as farm-state Republicans publicly break with Trump over the policy.

top.title: Rubio says US invited Putin to G20 summit in Miami
top.description: The announcement followed a closed-door meeting between Rubio and Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov at the UN General Assembly.

top.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in New York sexual assault case
top.description: The judge called him "the literal face of the Me Too movement" and ordered the sentence to run consecutive to a pending California term.

top.title: Iran's Pezeshkian calls country a 'victim' in rare wartime UN address
top.description: Speaking a day after Trump threatened to "annihilate" Iran, the Iranian president defended Tehran's actions and warned against using the Strait of Hormuz for aggression.

top.title: Tigray declares 'defensive war' as forces seize airport, clash with federal troops
top.description: Fighting spread to the Afar region as the TPLF seized Mekelle's airport and Ethiopian Airlines suspended all flights to Tigray.

top.title: Judge blocks deportation of man shot by ICE in Austin
top.description: A federal judge ordered Wilber Rafael Garces Perez to appear at a Sept. 30 hearing, temporarily halting his removal while a lawsuit proceeds.

top.title: Trump holds first meeting with US-backed Venezuelan leader at UN
top.description: The talks with interim President Delcy Rodríguez took place near the New York jail where ousted leader Nicolás Maduro awaits trial.

top.title: UK and France warn of escalating Russian hybrid warfare threat
top.description: European leaders are issuing urgent warnings about Russia's expanding campaign of sabotage, cyberattacks, and military provocations across the continent.

top.title: Severed cable and blown circuit ground thousands of Northeast flights
top.description: A failed FAA circuit and an accidentally cut backup fiber line halted flights at Newark and Philadelphia for hours, canceling over 900 flights.

top.title: GOP candidates quietly shed Trump branding as midterms loom
top.description: With Trump's approval at a record-low 32%, Republican candidates are downplaying ties to the president on policy and in campaign messaging.

top.title: North Korea tests new hypersonic missile as Kim warns of 'incurable headache' for enemies
top.description: Kim Jong Un oversaw the launch of two short-range ballistic missiles on Sept. 20, the country's 14th ballistic missile test this year.

top.title: Supreme Court's shadow docket now outpaces its formal rulings, ProPublica finds
top.description: The court issued more unsigned, unexplained emergency orders than traditional argued decisions last term — a first in modern history, according to experts.

top.title: US and Iran hold first direct talks in months at UN General Assembly
top.description: Trump said envoys Witkoff and Kushner had a "very good" three-hour meeting with Iranian officials, with another session planned soon.

top.title: Paramount settles with states, clearing $110B Warner Bros. merger
top.description: The deal removes the last major legal obstacle after 12 state attorneys general sued to block the acquisition on antitrust grounds.

top.title: AMD surpasses $1 trillion market cap for first time on AI demand
top.description: Shares surged to a record high Monday as investors bet on the chipmaker's expanding role in AI computing, particularly for CPU-heavy agent workloads.

top.title: Macron rebukes Trump on Gaza in farewell UN speech
top.description: The French president called Trump's claimed peace a "spectacle that should shame us all," saying humanitarian access has not resumed.

top.title: DHS opens probe into ICE shooting of DoorDash driver in Austin
top.description: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, 28, was shot in the torso during a delivery and later released from the hospital into ICE custody.

top.title: Putin's United Russia retains parliament majority in tightly controlled vote
top.description: Preliminary results show the ruling party winning roughly 355 of 450 Duma seats after a three-day election that sidelined opposition candidates.

top.title: Trump signs Greenland security deal with Denmark at U.N.
top.description: The trilateral agreement permits two new U.S. military bases and a missile defense system on the Arctic island while reaffirming Danish sovereignty.

top.title: Carney and Macron pledge joint space, defense work at symbolic island summit
top.description: Meeting on French territory off Canada's coast, the leaders tasked their agencies to co-develop space launch systems amid strained U.S. ties.

top.title: Ukraine launches 'largest ever' drone attack on Moscow
top.description: Over 1,000 drones targeted Russia overnight Sunday, damaging the Moscow Oil Refinery on the final day of parliamentary elections.

top.title: FBI was building bribery case around Collins before Trump shut it down, ProPublica reports
top.description: A convicted defense contractor told agents he funneled $150,000 to Collins' super PAC through a shell company in exchange for federal contracts.

top.title: AfD wins second German state as Merz vows to stay on
top.description: Exit polls show the far-right party took Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania with 37%, while Merz's CDU slumped to a historic low of 5.5%.

top.title: Iran threatens 'painful' strikes on U.S. bases across Mideast
top.description: Tehran's military command claims intelligence of planned U.S. strikes, while senior officials signal willingness to revive collapsed June framework deal.

top.title: Cuba walks out of UN as Trump calls it a 'failed state'
top.description: Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla led the delegation out after Trump predicted Cuba's communist government "will fall."

top.title: Former logger Troy Jackson aims to flip Collins' Maine Senate seat
top.description: A New York Times profile highlights the toss-up race between the progressive Democrat and the five-term Republican incumbent.

top.title: CENTCOM says 1B barrels of oil crossed Hormuz under US military escort
top.description: Adm. Brad Cooper said Saturday that Iran has "exported zero barrels" due to the U.S. blockade as shipping volume hits a six-month high.

top.title: Trump tells UN that AI will now be called 'super intelligence'
top.description: The president said U.S. government documents would replace "artificial intelligence" with "super intelligence," calling the term more accurate.

top.title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport after overnight air-raid alerts
top.description: Flightradar24 placed King Khalid International Airport at its maximum disruption index as flights were delayed and canceled Saturday.

top.title: State Dept. approves possible $2.68B air defense sale to Ukraine
top.description: The proposed deal covers missiles, counter-drone radars and launchers as Russian aerial bombs struck a Sumy apartment building, killing two.

top.title: Trump defends Iran war in address to UN General Assembly
top.description: The president accused Tehran of stalling negotiations until after the midterms and dismissed domestic political concerns over the nearly seven-month conflict.

top.title: U.S. intelligence finds Russia using AI deepfakes to target midterms
top.description: Classified assessments reveal the Kremlin authorized a covert campaign using AI-generated celebrity deepfakes to sow division ahead of November's elections.

top.title: Google says Gemini autonomously hacked three firms during cybersecurity test
top.description: Google is the fourth major AI lab to disclose that its models broke loose during security evaluations conducted by the same testing firm, Irregular.

top.title: Trump, Mamdani agree to advance Queens housing plan at Gracie Mansion
top.description: The president's first visit to the NYC mayoral residence since 1981 yielded a commitment to deepen talks on the $21 billion Sunnyside Yard project.

top.title: Amnesty says US deportees in Equatorial Guinea beaten, arrested in retaliation
top.description: Lawyers and rights groups say two men held at a hotel-turned-prison were hooded and beaten by police after reporting abuse by authorities.

top.title: At least 22 U.S. troops killed in Iran war, exceeding Pentagon's public count
top.description: The Washington Post reported Friday that at least four more service members have died than the Pentagon has disclosed, citing six U.S. officials.

top.title: TV networks boycott Trump helipad debut over CNN ban
top.description: ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC joined CNN in refusing pool coverage, leaving the president's remarks inaudible on the White House livestream.

top.title: AI-generated false report nearly triggered US-China military clash, CNN reports
top.description: An AI chatbot wrongly identified a Chinese ship's cargo as nuclear weapons components, prompting armed personnel and aircraft to mobilize before the error was caught.

top.title: South Korea's Lee rules out combat role in Middle East
top.description: The president said Seoul would not deploy troops to join the Iran war but is weighing limited measures to protect shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: Trump proposes $5B fund to rebuild Gulf energy sites
top.description: The investment fund would help Middle Eastern nations restore infrastructure damaged in the Iran war and reduce reliance on the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: Newsom signs order advancing AI 'kill switch' mandate
top.description: The California governor cited federal inaction and recent AI safety incidents, including the Hugging Face hack, in pushing accelerated oversight rules.

top.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire chairman
top.description: The 96-year-old investor named his son Howard as his successor and will stay on the board as chairman emeritus.

top.title: Trump called off Houthi strikes as bombs were loaded onto warplanes
top.description: Saudi Crown Prince MBS urged intervention, but the president reversed himself twice in two weeks, halting the operation on Sunday.

top.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to 31-year high of 1.25%
top.description: The widely expected hike, the sixth since March 2024, came amid rising inflation, a weak yen, and growing pressure from Washington.

top.title: Democratic strategists urge candidates not to provoke tech PACs over AI
top.description: Party strategists are privately urging battleground candidates to avoid strong AI stances, fearing millions in retaliatory super PAC spending.

top.title: Trump orders H-1B visa scrutiny for employers that lay off U.S. workers
top.description: The executive order directs agencies to weigh recent or planned layoffs when reviewing H-1B petitions but stops short of an outright ban.

top.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping 'largest theft' in history
top.description: Unredacted filings in the New York Times' copyright suit show executives at both companies privately acknowledged AI training harmed publishers.

top.title: State Dept. approves $24.3B F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia
top.description: The deal for 48 fighter jets advances despite U.S. intelligence warnings that China could access sensitive stealth technology through Riyadh's ties with Beijing.

top.title: Trump attacks Supreme Court over tariff, citizenship rulings
top.description: The president accused the justices of "faulty, political, and ridiculous decisions" that he claimed cost the U.S. trillions of dollars.

top.title: First new wild cat species in a century found in Bolivia
top.description: Researchers formally described the tilcayo, a small spotted cat from Bolivia's cloud forests, in a study that also splits tiger cats into five species.

top.title: Russia, China veto UN panel monitoring Iran sanctions
top.description: The panel's mandate expires Sept. 27, leaving no functioning body to oversee compliance with reimposed nuclear sanctions on Tehran.

top.title: Trump says he is creating 'AI Force,' will name AI czar
top.description: The president compared the new body to the Space Force he established in 2019, pledging to protect AI growth while using existing laws to police misuse.

top.title: UN mission says US strikes on Iran school constitute war crimes
top.description: The report also found Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity during a crackdown on anti-government protests.

top.title: China presses Iran to rein in Houthis after Saudi appeal
top.description: Beijing privately urged Tehran to curb the Houthis as their two-week offensive reshapes Yemen's Red Sea coast and threatens global energy routes.

top.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump mail-ballot plan for midterms
top.description: The ruling preserves mail-in voting procedures nationwide after 21 states and D.C. sued to stop USPS from screening ballots under a Trump executive order.

top.title: Rand Paul blocks AI 'kill switch' bill on Senate floor
top.description: Sen. Kennedy's bill would have required AI developers to build emergency shutoffs, but Paul objected, calling it a threat to innovation.

top.title: House holds Leon Black in contempt over Epstein probe
top.description: The DOJ will now decide whether to prosecute the Apollo co-founder, who defied subpoenas seeking testimony and nondisclosure agreements.

top.title: Trump demands childhood vaccines be split into five doses
top.description: Experts call the plan "buffoonery," saying one-fifth doses would be ineffective and leave children unprotected against disease.

top.title: CDC stalls COVID vaccine orders for children's program
top.description: The agency has not begun accepting state orders for the Vaccines for Children program, disrupting the usual fall vaccination schedule.

top.title: Russian drone found on Polish beach carried live warhead, prosecutors confirm
top.description: Poland also scrambled jets and closed two airports Wednesday after fresh Russian drone strikes targeted western Ukraine near the border.

top.title: Xi Jinping health rumors swirl after early BRICS departure
top.description: China and India have pushed back on unverified claims that Xi fell ill at the New Delhi summit, as attention turns to a planned meeting with Trump.

top.title: Kosovo ex-President Thaci sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
top.description: The Hague tribunal convicted Thaci and three other former KLA commanders of murder, torture and arbitrary detention during the 1998-99 war.

top.title: US held secret talks with Houthis in Oman after Red Sea seizure
top.description: The previously undisclosed Sunday meeting at the U.S. Embassy in Muscat came days after the Houthis captured Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline.

top.title: RFK Jr. discloses $250K in gifts from donor
top.description: Kennedy's financial ethics filing reveals free flights to Fiji and Greece and a D.C. vacation home, all from security consultant Gavin de Becker.

top.title: Apple explores return to server market with Nvidia tech
top.description: CEO John Ternus is backing a plan to sell AI servers powered by M8 Ultra chips, targeting a 2029 launch, according to The Information.

top.title: Lavrov says Russia ready for Ukraine talks but firm on keeping NATO from its borders
top.description: Moscow is open to bilateral and trilateral negotiations and plans to meet Rubio at the U.N. General Assembly later this month.

top.title: Iowa GOP Senate hopeful Hinson pulls away from Trump
top.description: Rep. Ashley Hinson skipped Trump's Dallas rally and will not attend a Vance event Friday as she fights for a toss-up Senate seat.

top.title: Von der Leyen to invite AI labs for slowdown talks
top.description: The EU chief also unveiled the EU Kids Act, which would ban social media for children under 13 across the 27-member bloc.

top.title: Pentagon hand-picks fit troops for Hegseth speech
top.description: Commanders must select service members who pass waist-to-height ratio tests and grooming standards to attend the Sept. 30 address.

top.title: Cook, Altman, Huang to attend Trump-Xi state dinner
top.description: Top AI and tech leaders will join President Trump's White House state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping next week amid tensions over AI regulation and trade.

top.title: Rubio announces visa curbs on South Africa officials
top.description: The restrictions target those involved in land seizures, race-based discrimination, or incitement of violence against minority groups.

top.title: Sanders and Bannon unite at rally urging AI restrictions
top.description: The unlikely allies spoke Tuesday at the "Pro-Human Assembly" in Washington as more than 50 organizations launched a coalition to keep AI under human control.

top.title: Minnesota judge says Trump ICE surge posed 'grave threat' to rule of law
top.description: Judge Patrick Schiltz, a Bush appointee, described months of chaos in which ICE violated nearly 100 court orders in January alone.

top.title: Bessent clashes with Democrats over inflation at House hearing
top.description: The Treasury secretary defended the administration's economic record as 10-year yields hit their highest since 2007 and gas prices topped $4 a gallon.

top.title: Von der Leyen decries Russian 'aggression' after dual NATO incidents
top.description: A Russian frigate fired flares at a Danish helicopter Monday, and NATO jets shot down a drone over Lithuania hours later.

top.title: Judge orders 30-day notice before Kennedy Center demolition
top.description: The ruling came after photos showed Trump reviewing a printout aboard Air Force One that appeared to read "Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED."

top.title: Patel defends loosened FBI hiring standards at Senate hearing
top.description: The FBI director told senators the policy change on bestiality and prostitution was meant to protect trafficking victims from automatic disqualification.

top.title: Space Force has deployed weapons to orbit, Air Force secretary reveals
top.description: The first-ever public confirmation that U.S. weapons systems are circling the Earth came at AFA's Air, Space and Cyber conference.

top.title: Carney welcomes EU associate membership bid despite Trump threats
top.description: Canada's PM told the European Parliament the alliance would ensure "no one can control our open markets" or "undermine our freedoms."

top.title: Germany rejects AI pause, calls for U.S.-China oversight
top.description: Berlin said halting AI development is not viable for Europe, even as Anthropic's CEO urged the industry to slow capability gains.

top.title: EPA moves to permanently end carbon rules for power plants
top.description: The agency is finalizing the repeal of Biden-era standards and proposing to block any future greenhouse gas regulations for the sector.

top.title: Trump says 'major progress' made on US Army base in Poland
top.description: The president said a location could be announced "very soon," calling the potential base a historic step for the NATO allies.

top.title: Anthropic reports second straight adjusted profit ahead of IPO
top.description: The AI company told shareholders it expects a Q3 adjusted operating profit as it prepares for a mid-October Nasdaq listing, the FT reported.

top.title: Modi warns against weaponizing critical minerals at BRICS summit in New Delhi
top.description: Without naming China directly, the PM called for inclusive technology adoption as the bloc wrapped up its two-day summit.

top.title: Zuckerberg, Musk and Huang convinced Trump to block AI regulator, WSJ reports
top.description: The three tech CEOs separately lobbied the president to shelve a proposed industry-funded oversight body for artificial intelligence.

top.title: Russian drone hits train 2 km from Polish border after Johnson passes through
top.description: A jet-propelled drone struck a Kyiv-to-Warsaw passenger train at Yahodyn, shortly after Boris Johnson and European officials used the same route.

top.title: Altman says OpenAI IPO won't happen until 2027
top.description: The CEO told Fortune that going public now would be "ill-advised" given AI safety concerns and fallout from a recent hack.

top.title: Trump administration preparing warning signs outside Smithsonian museum
top.description: Interior Secretary Burgum's letter reveals plans for about a dozen signs accusing the National Museum of American History of ideological bias.

top.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI slowdown after report exposes Claude misuse
top.description: Dario Amodei's Saturday essay followed a threat report detailing how adversaries used Claude for autonomous drones, surveillance and bioweapons research.

top.title: Iran's Pezeshkian says US failed to topple Tehran, vows not to surrender
top.description: Speaking in New Delhi ahead of the BRICS summit, the Iranian president accused Washington of blocking food and medicine and called its campaign "the most savage thing."

top.title: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles says she is cancer-free
top.description: Wiles announced Wednesday that pathology results from the Mayo Clinic came back clear, six months after her early-stage breast cancer diagnosis.

top.title: Ukraine hits Russian rocket fuel plant in overnight strike
top.description: The Tolyattikauchuk facility in Samara produces synthetic rubbers used in solid rocket fuel for tactical and ballistic missiles.

top.title: TSA restores gate access without tickets for first time since 9/11
top.description: The new Gateside by TSA PreCheck program launched this week at 13 airports, letting eligible travelers enter secure areas to greet or see off loved ones.

top.title: Trump deploys $138M through new super PACs to defend GOP majorities
top.description: The spending surge follows months of Republican criticism that MAGA Inc. was sitting on its $400 million war chest while candidates faced tough races.

top.title: U.S. links Chinese satellite imagery to Iran strike that killed 3 troops
top.description: Officials say the finding is the most definitive proof to date that Chinese assistance to Iran has led to American casualties.

top.title: OpenAI agents attacked RubyGems before Hugging Face breach
top.description: The Wall Street Journal reported the previously undisclosed May cyberattack, adding a new chapter to concerns over autonomous AI systems.

top.title: China calls for UN-led AI governance after dismissing US slowdown push
top.description: Beijing shifted from denouncing Silicon Valley's AI warnings as "fearmongering" to urging multilateral cooperation, ahead of a planned Xi-Trump meeting.

top.title: Nation marks 25th anniversary of Sept. 11 attacks
top.description: Ceremonies at Ground Zero, the Pentagon and Shanksville honored nearly 3,000 victims, with a new permanent moment of silence for those lost to 9/11 illnesses.

top.title: Congress scrambles to respond to AI doomsday warnings
top.description: Anthropic insider warnings that AI could end humanity have lawmakers seeking answers, but gridlock and a packed calendar leave little room for action.

top.title: Trump attacks his own Supreme Court picks over mail ballot ruling
top.description: All three justices he appointed joined the majority blocking his administration's postal restrictions ahead of midterms.

top.title: CIA releases 69 classified briefs on 25th anniversary of 9/11
top.description: The documents reveal repeated pre-attack warnings to the Clinton and Bush White Houses, including a 1998 alert about a plane attack on a U.S. city.

top.title: DOJ deports Afghan woman using once-dormant terror court
top.description: The Alien Terrorist Removal Court, created in 1996 but never previously used, handled its first case after Nazira Haji Zada waived her appeal.

top.title: Putin rejects energy ceasefire before winter, FT reports
top.description: The Kremlin believes continued strikes on Ukraine's energy grid will force Kyiv into concessions as cold weather approaches, despite Trump claiming a deal was reached.

top.title: Anthropic says Iran-linked actors used Claude AI to target US Navy ships
top.description: A 154-page threat report details how operatives compiled targeting handbooks on warships, tracked personnel and researched shipboard vulnerabilities.

top.title: Putin slams West's 'ugly' tactics at BRICS forum in New Delhi
top.description: Modi and Putin led calls for deeper economic ties as the expanded bloc convened ahead of Saturday's leaders' summit.

top.title: Ex-CIA chief Brennan subpoenaed in Trump 'grand conspiracy' probe
top.description: Brennan's attorney disclosed the grand jury subpoena Monday, calling the DOJ investigation a "far-reaching" probe into officials who investigated Trump.

top.title: 9/11 illness deaths now triple the original attack toll
top.description: On the 25th anniversary, newly released city records reveal officials knew air at Ground Zero was toxic while publicly declaring it safe.

top.title: Africa accounts for two-thirds of ISIS activity, US panel warns on 9/11 anniversary
top.description: A House Homeland Security Committee report finds seven of the 10 countries with the most terrorism deaths are in Africa.

top.title: Trump administration pushes AI into medical care despite safety concerns
top.description: HHS is developing Medicare reimbursement pathways for AI-supported care and backing pilot programs for autonomous AI doctors, alarming some officials.

top.title: Acting Navy secretary says Iran 'blew the hell out of' US base in Bahrain
top.description: Hung Cao's comment marks the first on-the-record acknowledgment by a senior official of the scale of damage to the Fifth Fleet's headquarters.

top.title: Canada and Ukraine sign 100-year partnership deal
top.description: The agreement, signed Thursday in Calgary, includes a $350 million air defense package and plans to jointly produce millions of drones.

top.title: Putin ally bankrolled Trump Jr.'s Bahamas wedding, ProPublica reports
top.description: Umar Kremlev, head of the International Boxing Association, covered hundreds of thousands of dollars in expenses for the May celebration, according to the investigation.

top.title: Vance secretly sought military commanders' candid views on Iran war
top.description: The vice president bypassed the Pentagon to call generals directly, hearing warnings about depleted stockpiles and dim prospects for success.

top.title: ECB raises interest rates to 2.50% amid Middle East inflation pressures
top.description: The Governing Council lifted the deposit rate by 25 basis points in what economists say is the ECB's shortest hiking cycle in 15 years.

top.title: China's spy chief names U.S. AI models as threats to national security
top.description: State Security Minister Chen Yixin singled out Anthropic's Claude Mythos and OpenAI's ChatGPT-5.5-Cyber as risks to critical infrastructure ahead of Trump-Xi talks.

top.title: Iran restarts ballistic missile production underground
top.description: Tehran is assembling both liquid- and solid-fueled missiles from prewar stockpiles at subterranean sites, according to The Wall Street Journal.

top.title: Pilot warned of excessive speed before deadly Miami cargo crash, NTSB says
top.description: The other pilot gave "not a consistent verbal response" to repeated speed warnings in the final 102 seconds of cockpit audio.

top.title: Pentagon recruits immigrants as ICE deports troops' families
top.description: Green-card military recruits rose 62% since 2021, even as over 50 service members' relatives have been detained under Trump's immigration crackdown.

top.title: Rhode Island Gov. McKee ousted in Democratic primary
top.description: Former CVS executive Helena Foulkes defeated the incumbent by nearly 25 points, fueled by voter anger over a stalled bridge project.

top.title: Zelensky's plane nearly hit by Russian drone over Moldova, Norway's PM says
top.description: A suspected Shahed-type drone came close to striking the Ukrainian president's aircraft as it departed Moldova for King Harald V's funeral in Oslo.

top.title: Trump says he'll remove 15% tariff on Irish whiskey
top.description: The president made the announcement during the prizegiving ceremony at the Amgen Irish Open, held at his Doonbeg golf resort.

top.title: Sanders convenes Senate AI briefing after Anthropic researcher's resignation
top.description: The Sept. 16 briefing will feature Geoffrey Hinton and other AI experts as Congress weighs a bill to ban superintelligent AI.

top.title: Tate brothers denied bail in Miami extradition fight
top.description: A federal judge ruled Andrew and Tristan Tate are flight risks and must remain jailed while contesting extradition to the U.K. on 59 sex crime charges.
